    r = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2,8) for v in row))
    markers = [(c,v) for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v in (2,8)]
    # Marker colors determine stem length: 2 reaches four rows above;
    # 8 reaches three rows above, with 1s immediately beneath its tip.
    for c,v in markers:
        length = 4 if v == 2 else 3
        tip = max(0, r-length)
        out[tip][c] = v
        for rr in range(tip+1,r):
            out[rr][c] = 1
    return out
